policy.trainingAllowed: Only sources whose per-image licence is verifiable and permits commercial use may be trained on and shipped. A source-level licence claim does not override unverifiable image provenance.
policy.evalOnly: Sources that may be used to measure a model but never to train it or ship derived weights.
policy.rejected: Sources that are not used at all: provenance is scraped or the licence is unknown.
policy.attribution: Every image carries sourceUrl + attribution in the manifest; CC-BY and CC-BY-SA require a non-empty attribution string, enforced by dataset.validate_manifest.
policy.storage: Images never live in Git. They are downloaded into ml/data/raw/ (git-ignored) or an external bucket; only manifests, hashes and provenance logs are committed.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons — Indian cuisine photographs
sources.accessNotes: MediaWiki API, no credentials. Search namespace 6 (File:), filter extmetadata licence per file, download a 512 px thumbnail, record description URL and artist.
sources.licenseNotes: Licence is per file and machine-readable (extmetadata.LicenseShortName), with the author string for attribution. Files whose licence is not on the allow-list are skipped, not guessed at.
sources.redistribution: Images stay under their original licence; the manifest records licence, source URL and attribution. Share-alike files (CC-BY-SA) are flagged so the shipped corpus attribution can satisfy them.
sources.expectedImages: varies by dish; a handful to a few hundred per class
sources.labels: free-text file descriptions; mapped by our own search terms per class
risks: Search relevance: a hit on 'thepla' may show a thali containing it. Requires human review before training.
Licence laundering: a Commons upload can itself be a copyright violation. Only use files with a licence template and a named author, and spot-check before shipping.

sources.name: Open Images V7 (Google)
sources.accessNotes: Public CSV annotations + image URLs / TFRecord shards. Images carry their own licences (a large share CC BY 2.0); annotations are CC BY 4.0.
sources.licenseNotes: Annotation licence is CC BY 4.0, but each image has its own licence and attribution requirement fetched per image. Class list covers 'Dosa', 'Idli', 'Samosa', 'Gulab jamun', 'Jalebi', 'Naan', 'Biryani'-adjacent plates only sparsely.
sources.redistribution: Per-image licence; attribution required for CC BY. Verify each image rather than trusting the dataset-level claim.
sources.expectedImages: a few hundred across all Indian dishes combined
sources.labels: 600 boxable classes, very few Indian dishes
risks: Coverage is thin for regional Indian dishes — cannot carry the corpus alone.
Per-image licence verification adds real work per image.

sources.name: BharatBite owned capture
sources.accessNotes: Photographs taken by the owner/team in homes, canteens and thali restaurants in Gujarat and Maharashtra. Uploaded to private storage, then hashed into the manifest.
sources.licenseNotes: Owned outright; no third-party rights. Consent required for any identifiable person in frame.
sources.redistribution: Full rights; may be used for training, evaluation and marketing with consent.
sources.labels: exactly our 50 classes, photographed as served
risks: Slowest source and cannot be automated.
Distribution bias: one region's plating will not generalise to the rest of India without breadth of locations.

sources.name: Kaggle — Indian Food Images Dataset (80 classes, 4,000 images)
sources.accessNotes: Requires a Kaggle account and API token; the archive is 372 MB.
sources.licenseNotes: The dataset card says 'Other (specified in description)' and the description states the images are collected from Google Images. There is no per-image licence, author or source URL, so neither redistribution nor commercial training can be justified.
sources.redistribution: None. Not redistributed, not committed, not shipped.
sources.labels: 80 Indian dishes (covers many of ours: idli, dosa, samosa, jalebi, gulab jamun, pav bhaji…)
risks: Scraped provenance: unusable for a model we ship.
Widely used in tutorials, which is exactly why it looks acceptable at a glance.
sources.rejection: Excluded from training. If used at all, only as an internal sanity probe whose numbers are never reported as our accuracy and whose images never enter a shipped artifact.

sources.name: Hugging Face — rajistics/indian_food_images (20 classes)
sources.licenseNotes: Derived from the Kaggle set above (Google Images provenance, class names such as 'paani_puri', 'kaathi_rolls'). The Hub card carries no licence that survives inspection.
sources.labels: 20 classes incl. burger/pizza/momos — only partly Indian
risks: Same scraped provenance as its parent dataset.
Class list includes non-Indian items, so it flatters top-1.
sources.rejection: Excluded from training for the same reason as its parent.

sources.name: Kaggle — Indian Food Images (20 folders × 100)
sources.licenseNotes: Card claims Apache 2.0, but the description credits Google Images as the source. A licence cannot be granted by someone who does not hold the rights.
sources.labels: 20 dishes (aloo fry, biryani, butter chicken, dosa, idli, gulab jamun, jalebi, kebab, palak paneer, puri, rajma chawal, rasmalai, roti, sambar, samosa, vada…)
risks: A permissive label on scraped images is worse than an honest 'unknown' because it invites shipping.
sources.rejection: Rejected outright: the licence claim contradicts the stated source.

sources.name: Food-101 (ETH Zürich)
sources.licenseNotes: Images were collected from foodspotting.com; the dataset is distributed for research, without per-image licences. Only six classes overlap loosely with Indian dishes (e.g. 'samosa', 'naan', 'biryani'-adjacent), none reliably.
sources.rejection: Not used: no Indian coverage worth the licence risk.

sources.name: IndianFoodNet (paper, IIETA)
sources.accessNotes: The paper (CC BY 4.0) describes ~5,500 images across 30 classes with bounding boxes, but does not publish a stable, licensed download endpoint.
sources.licenseNotes: Article licence does not extend to the images; image provenance is not stated per file.
sources.labels: 30 Indian dishes with some overlap (aloo gobi, bhindi masala, biryani, chole, dal, dosa, gulab jamun, idli…)
risks: No verifiable licence or download endpoint; a request to the authors is needed.
sources.rejection: Not used pending an explicit written licence from the authors.
